note: The Wet invoering BSN en voorzieningen digitale overheid BES (Staatsblad 2025, 304), read 2026-10-31, art. I: the Wet algemene bepalingen burgerservicenummer (the Netherlands' law of the citizen service number, BSN) and the rules under it apply also in the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba (new art. 1a(1)); the executive council (bestuurscollege) gives the BSN to a person at once on their registration in the basic register of personal data under the Wet basisadministraties persoonsgegevens BES, unless one has already been given (new art. 8(2)), and to everyone already registered when the provision comes into force (new art. 22(1)). The decree of 3 November 2025 (Staatsblad 2025, 326), read 2026-10-31: the law comes into force on 11 November 2025, except parts of its art. II (on the BES register's own law) and art. VA, so art. I is in force. So the Caribbean Netherlands' residents hold the Netherlands' number, the BSN, as the Netherlands' file has it; that file's issuer is the municipality, which in the Caribbean Netherlands is the public body's executive council, as art. I says. The CRIB number the Belastingdienst Caribisch Nederland keeps for tax, and the identity card's earlier ID-nummer (the date of birth and a two-digit code under the Wet identiteitskaarten BES, as the research report on number use in the Caribbean Netherlands, May 2024, describes it), aren't modelled. READING: art. 1a(2) defers only the Wabb's art. 13 to a later date, which isn't the giving of the number.

sources.title: Wet invoering BSN en voorzieningen digitale overheid BES, Staatsblad 2025, 304
sources.said: De Wet algemene bepalingen burgerservicenummer wordt als volgt gewijzigd: ... Deze wet en de daarop berustende bepalingen zijn mede van toepassing in de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba. ... Het bestuurscollege kent onmiddellijk na een inschrijving in de basisadministratie als bedoeld in artikel 5 van de Wet basisadministraties persoonsgegevens BES, aan de ingeschrevene een burgerservicenummer toe, tenzij aan hem reeds een burgerservicenummer is toegekend.
